mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d S&P 500 returns is above -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A current unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations fall, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending supply shock that disrupts corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC for INDPRO in late-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS and 5d S&P 500 returns is negative or |Rank IC| < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue visibility and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals aggressive policy restraint, increasing the cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in tightening cycles is below 0.03.
